blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
This paper is a Track 2 reproducibility companion to an ICPR 2026 study
on risky tackle detection in American football practice
videos [ 8 ] . The original work fine-tuned a Video Vision
Transformer (ViViT) on 733 clips labeled with the SATT-3 rubric. It used
focal loss, Taguchi L 18 L_{18} augmentation, and 5-fold cross-validation.
It reported risky-class recall of 0.67 and risky-class F1 of 0.59. This
companion documents the released artifact and traces those numbers to
specific scripts, fold outputs, and aggregation files. The reproduced
headline is run_15 . It combines Gaussian noise with static
brightness decrease and uses no rotation and no flip. Its fold-mean
risky recall is 0.667 and its fold-mean risky F1 is 0.588. These values
match the published headline after rounding. The ablation shows that
brightness is the dominant factor. Its risky-recall main-effect range is
0.055, which is larger than the ranges for rotation, flip, and noise.
Without augmentation, ViViT reaches risky recall of 0.545 and does not
exceed the C3D baseline of 0.583. The raw clips show identifiable
student athletes, so they cannot be redistributed. The artifact provides
a public sample for pipeline checks and a controlled route for full-data
review.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Head and neck injuries in American football are strongly linked to poor
tackling form. Practice is where form is taught and corrected. Coaches
cannot review every repetition on film. Risky repetitions can therefore
go unnoticed. Automated detection can rank clips for coach review and
help standardize feedback across sessions. Nafi et al. established the
task with a 3D convolutional network on practice clips [ 4 ] .
Follow-up work isolated the relevant athletes through instance
segmentation [ 5 ] . The broader goal is a safety pipeline that
works under tight data and compute constraints.

美式足球的头部和颈部的伤痕 与穷人有密切的联系
处理形式。 实践就是传授和纠正形式。 教练
无法审查每一次重复的电影。 因此,风险重复可能
注意点 自动侦测可以对剪辑进行排级,以供教练审查,
帮助将各次会议的反馈标准化。 纳菲等. 设立
任务与练习片段的3D演化网络[4]。
通过实例隔离相关运动员的后续工作
分化[5]. 更大的目标是安全管道
在数据紧凑和计算限制下工作。

blocks.en:
This companion uses a design-of-experiments view. Taguchi orthogonal
arrays provide a compact way to study augmentation factors under a fixed
compute budget [ 7 ] . The tackle task needs this kind of
controlled ablation because the full factorial augmentation space is
large and video training is expensive.
blocks.zh:
这个同伴使用设计实验视图. 田口正肠
阵列提供了一种紧凑的方法,用于研究固定的增量系数
计算预算 [7]. 任务需要这样
控制衰减,因为全因子增强空间是
大型和视频培训费用昂贵。

blocks.en:
Four constraints make the task hard. The labels are imbalanced, with
64.7% safe and 35.3% risky clips. The discriminative signal often
appears near first contact. Training is compute intensive. The footage
shows identifiable student athletes and is governed by an institutional
review protocol.
blocks.zh:

64.7%的安全性和35.3%的风险片段. 往往带有歧视性的信号
出现于接近第一次接触。 训练很密集 镜头
显示可识别的学生运动员 并由一个机构管理
审查协议。

blocks.en:
The original study [ 8 ] uses 733 single-athlete tackle clips
recorded against a padded dummy. The set contains 474 safe clips and 259
risky clips. Each clip is trimmed to 32 frames, with 15 frames before
and 16 frames after the first point of contact (FPOC). FPOC localization
is manual in [ 8 ] . A zero-shot alternative, GRAZE, was later
developed on the same dataset [ 9 ] . Labels follow the SATT-3 rubric. Scores of 0 or 1 map to risky. Scores of 2 or 3 map to safe.
The model is ViViT [ 1 ] , initialized from google/vivit-b-16x2-kinetics400 pretrained on
Kinetics-400 [ 2 ] . Inputs are 32 frames at 224 × 224 224\times 224 .
Training uses focal loss [ 3 ] [ 6 ] , balanced sampling, 5-fold
stratified cross-validation, and a Taguchi L 18 L_{18} augmentation
schedule. The headline is risky recall 0.67 and risky F1 0.59. The C3D
baseline reaches risky recall 0.583 and risky F1 0.560 [ 4 ] .
The model in this artifact is specifically ViViT. It is not a per-frame
image ViT.

blocks.en:
This companion makes five contributions. First, it provides a documented
pipeline that can be tested on a public sample. Authorized users can run
it on the full dataset after local path configuration. Second, it maps
the main reported numbers to scripts, configurations, and output files.
Third, it explains the data-access restriction for the IRB-constrained
clips. Fourth, it states that the heatmap values are the fold-mean opt_* metrics selected with per-fold macro-F1 threshold tuning.
Fifth, it reports a Taguchi L 18 L_{18} main-effects analysis and shows
that brightness decrease is the strongest augmentation factor.

The paper is organized as follows. Section 2 describes the
artifact and environment. Section 3 describes data access.
Section 4 traces the headline result. Section 5 reports the reproducibility analysis. Section 6 gives
lessons learned. Section 7 concludes.

The reported heatmap uses the opt_* columns.

The released scripts keep local path variables for run directories.
Reproducers must update those paths for their own storage. This keeps the
artifact close to the code used in the study while allowing review on a
different machine.

blocks.en:
Four dependency risks matter. The ViViT checkpoint should be cached if
the training system has limited internet access. The pinned transformers
version was validated with timm 0.4.12. Upgrading timm may change the
model loading path. Decord 0.6.0 may also require a source build on some
Linux systems. Writing taguchi_summary.xlsx needs the openpyxl engine for pandas. It is not currently pinned in Environment.yml , so a fresh install may need it added manually.

四个依赖风险很重要。 如果
培训系统的互联网接入有限。 固定式变压器
版本被验证为Timm 0.4.12. 提升imm可能会改变
模型加载路径 。 装饰品0.6.0还可能需要以某些来源为基础。
Linux系统. 写taguchi_summary.xlsx需要大熊猫的开放pyxl引擎. 它目前没有被困在环境中。 yml,所以新安装可能需要手动添加.

blocks.en: 2.3 Hardware and Compute Budget
blocks.zh: 2.3 硬件和计算预算

blocks.en:
The reported full-data runs used one NVIDIA H100-80GB GPU per job on PSC
Bridges-2 through an ACCESS allocation. The full sweep contains 20 runs
and 5 folds per run, for 100 model trainings. The job launcher processes
three runs per job and loops over folds 0 through 4. The full sweep was
run in batches. The cost was about 72 GPU-hours, or about 3 to 4 hours
per run. Gradient accumulation over 8 steps gives an effective batch size
of 16.
blocks.zh:
报告的全部数据运行使用 NVIDIA H100-80GB GPU 在PSC 的每个工作
通过Accessess分配的桥梁-2。 整个扫描包含20次运行
和每跑5折,用于100个模范训练. 任务启动程序
每份工作3次运行,循环0至4次折叠. 彻底扫荡
分批运行。 费用约为72 GPU小时,或3至4小时
每个运行。 8个步骤的渐变堆积使批量有效
页:1

blocks.en:
Storage is separate from compute. Each run keeps its own augmented train
and validation clips for every fold. The full Taguchi build occupies
about 700 GB. A reproducer with limited storage should process runs in
batches and archive metrics before deleting completed run directories.
blocks.zh:
储存与计算分开。 每趟列车都有自己的加载列车
和每个折叠的验证夹片。 整个田口的建筑占据了
约700GB. 存储量有限的复制人应进行处理
在删除已完成的运行目录之前,先进行批量和归档计量。

blocks.en:
The public-sample workflow is lighter. A single modern CUDA GPU can test
preprocessing, training, evaluation, and aggregation. Lower-memory GPUs
need a smaller batch size. Reducing the frame count below 32 is expected
to reduce risky recall, but that effect was not measured here.
blocks.zh:
公共抽样工作流程较轻. 单一的现代 CUDA GPU 可以测试
预处理、培训、评价和汇总。 下层GPU
需要较小的批量尺寸。 预计框架数将降至32以下
以降低风险召回, 但这种影响没有在这里衡量。

blocks.en: 3 Data Access and IRB Considerations
blocks.zh: 3 数据存取和IRB考虑

blocks.en:
The 733 clips show identifiable student athletes during practice. The
institutional review protocol does not permit public redistribution of
the raw clips. This restriction also covers the 178-clip subset first
used in [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh:
733片段在练习时显示可识别的学生运动员. 这个
机构审查协议不允许公众重新分配
原始剪辑。 此限制也先涵盖178clip子集
[4]中使用。

blocks.en:
The class distribution affects every metric. There are 474 safe clips
(64.7%) and 259 risky clips (35.3%). This is a 1.83 to 1 ratio. A
classifier that predicts safe for every clip reaches 64.7% accuracy but
misses every risky tackle. This failure mode motivates a recall-first
evaluation.
blocks.zh:
班级分布影响每个度量. 有474个安全夹片
(64.7%)和259个危险片段(35.3%)。 这是1.83比1的比例。 A级
预测每个片段安全性的分类器达到64.7%的准确度,但
错过了每一个危险的陷阱。 这种失败模式促使人们首先召回
评估。

blocks.en:
A public sample is available at https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/ahsanzaidi786/tacklenet-sample . It
supports environment setup, run-directory construction, preprocessing,
training, evaluation, and metric aggregation. It does not support
quantitative reproduction of the reported cross-validation metrics. Full
reproduction of Table 6 requires the full
733-clip dataset.
blocks.zh:
公众样本见https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/ahsanzaidi786/taclenet-sample。 这个
支持环境设置、运行指令构建、预处理、
培训、评价和衡量汇总。 它不支持
报告交叉验证指标的定量复制。 满
表6需要全文
733-clip数据集.

blocks.en:
Reviewers who need restricted clips for badge evaluation can request
access during review. Requests are routed through the RRPR chairs and
then to the authors. Each requester signs a data use agreement. The
agreement restricts use to the evaluation of this submission. It also
prohibits redistribution and re-identification. It requires deletion of
the clips after review closes. After the agreement is countersigned, the
data are delivered through a university-managed secure transfer service.
Access is limited to the named requester.
blocks.zh:
警徽评价需要限制剪辑的审校可以要求
审查期间的访问。 请求通过RRPR主席处理,
然后是给提交人的。 每个请求者签署数据使用协议. 这个
协议限制了对本呈件的评价。 还有
禁止重新分配和重新确认。 它要求删除
剪辑结束 协议签署后,
数据通过大学管理的安全转移服务提供。
访问仅限于指定的请求者.

blocks.zh: 4 转载标题成果

Twenty configurations were evaluated. Eighteen use the Taguchi L 18 L_{18} augmentation schedule. run_0 uses oversampling without
transformation. run_0_original uses neither oversampling nor
augmentation. Each configuration is evaluated with 5 stratified folds.
The headline result corresponds to run_15 . That run combines
Gaussian noise with static brightness decrease and uses no rotation and
no flip. It reaches risky recall 0.667 and risky F1 0.588.

blocks.en:
ViViT without augmentation reaches risky recall 0.545 in the archived
heatmap. This rounds to 0.55, not 0.58. The original ICPR narrative text
states this baseline as 0.58, which is close to the C3D value of 0.583.
This companion uses the heatmap value, 0.545, since the heatmap is the
direct source for these tables. Readers checking the original text
should expect this small difference. The best Taguchi configuration
exceeds C3D by 0.084 in risky recall and by 0.028 in risky F1. This
comparison is descriptive. The C3D baseline and the ViViT experiment
were not run under the same controlled protocol.
blocks.zh:
在档案中,没有增强的ViViT有可能被召回0.545
热图。 此轮为0.55,而非0.58. 最初的预防危机和复原方案说明文本
表示这一基线为0.58,接近0.583的C3D值。
这个伴星使用热映射值,0.545,因为热映射是
这些表格的直接来源。 检查原始文本的读者
应该能预料到这种小的差别。 最佳的塔口配置
危险召回时超过0.084C3D,危险F1时超过0.028C3D。 这个
比较是描述性的。 C3D基线和ViViT实验
没有在同一控制协议下运行。

blocks.en: 5 Reproducibility Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 可复制性分析

blocks.en: 5.1 Lineage and Aggregation
blocks.zh: 5.1 系系和综合

blocks.en:
The reported heatmap values are the threshold-tuned opt_* values. Each fold writes both standard and optimal metrics to metrics_summary.csv . consolidate_metrics.py gathers those
files and creates consolidated summaries. This is why Table 3 and Table 6 use threshold-tuned fold means.
blocks.zh:
报告的热映射值是阈值调定的 optQQ 值。 每个折叠都同时写出标准度量和最佳度量衡到度量衡_summary.csv. computed_meters.py 收集这些值.
并创建合并摘要。 这就是为什么表3和表6使用阈值调值折叠表示的原因。

blocks.en:
The practical path requirement is simple. BASE_RUNS_DIR must
point to a directory with the expected run_*/fold_* structure. RESULTS_BASE_DIR must point to the output tree that stores the
per-fold metrics_summary.csv files. Reviewers can check the
public-sample pipeline without the restricted clips.
blocks.zh:
实际路径要求很简单。 贝斯_RUNS_DIR 必须
指向一个具有预期运行%%/%%%结构的目录。 结果_ BASE_ DIR 必须指向存储该数据的输出树
每倍度量衡_summary.csv 文件. 审校可以检查
公共抽样管道没有限制片段。

blocks.en: 5.2 Taguchi L 18 L_{18} Factors
blocks.zh: 5.2 Taguchi L 18 LQQQ18] 因素

blocks.en:
The ablation varies four augmentation factors. Noise has 2 levels.
Brightness, rotation, and flip have 3 levels each. This gives a full
factorial space of 54 combinations. The Taguchi L 18 L_{18} array covers
the same factor set with 18 runs. This reduces the cost from about 160
to 220 GPU-hours to about 54 to 72 GPU-hours. The design estimates main
effects under an orthogonality assumption. It does not estimate factor
interactions.
blocks.zh:
膨胀因素有四个。 噪声有2级.
亮度,旋转和翻转各有3个级别. 这样就足够了
54个组合的系数空间。 Taguchi L 18 LQQQ18}阵列覆盖
相同的因数集,有18个运行。 这减少了大约160美元的费用。
220GPU小时到约54到72GPU小时. 设计估计主要
根据矫形假设产生的效果。 它不估计因数
互动。

blocks.en: Table 4: Taguchi L 18 L_{18} factors for the reported 733-clip heatmap. Brightness uses static increase and static decrease levels.
blocks.zh: 表4: 报告733-clip热映射的Taguchi L 18 L_{18]因子. 亮度使用静态增减水平.

blocks.en: Table 5: Taguchi main effects for risky-class recall. Values are computed from the 18 threshold-tuned heatmap recalls.
blocks.zh: 表5: Taguchi对危险阶层召回的主要影响。 数值是从18个阈值调温图回历计算出来的。

blocks.en:
Brightness has the largest range. Decreased brightness is the best
level. A plausible explanation is that reduced luminance suppresses
background clutter and makes the contact region more salient. Rotation
is second. No rotation is the best rotation level. Large geometric
changes can disturb orientation cues that matter for tackle form. Noise
and flip have smaller effects. The best observed run combines noise with
brightness decrease and uses no rotation and no flip.
blocks.zh:
亮度的射程最大. 减少的亮度是最好的
级别。 一个合理的解释是,减少亮度抑制
使联系区域更加突出。 旋转
为第二。 没有旋转是最好的旋转水平. 大几何
变化会干扰对处理形式很重要的方向提示。 噪声
而翻转的效果较小。 最好的观测运行结合了噪音和
亮度降低并使用不旋转和不翻转。

blocks.en: Table 6: Complete heatmap values used for the reproduction check. Values are fold means.
blocks.zh: 表6:用于复制检查的全热图值。 数值是折叠表示.

blocks.en: 5.3 Stability of Comparisons
blocks.zh: 5.3 比较的稳定性

blocks.en:
Across the 18 L 18 L_{18} runs, risky recall spans 0.498 to 0.667. The
standard deviation is 0.041. Risky F1 spans 0.497 to 0.588. Its standard
deviation is 0.020. F1 is more stable than recall. Augmentation mainly
changes the recall and precision tradeoff. Those shifts partly cancel in
F1.
blocks.zh:
在18L 18 LQQ 18]运行中,冒险召回的时间为0.498到0.667. 那个
标准偏差为0.041。 风险F1从0.497到0.588. 标准
偏差为0.020。 F1比回忆更稳定. 主要增加额
改变召回和精确的权衡 这些班次部分取消
F1 (英语).

blocks.en:
The comparison against C3D should be read with care. run_15 exceeds the C3D baseline by 0.084 recall and 0.028 F1. The comparison is
not fully controlled. The two systems were trained on different dataset
sizes and under different protocols. This companion documents the
conditions under which the reported result was obtained. It does not
claim a definitive superiority margin.
blocks.zh:
应仔细阅读与C3D的比较。 运行_15 超过 C3D 基线 0.084 回溯和 0.028 F1. 比较是
没有完全控制。 这两个系统接受了不同数据集的培训
大小和不同的协议。 这个伴奏记录
获得报告结果的条件。 没有
拥有绝对的优势

blocks.en:
Folds are assigned at the clip level using stratified splitting. The
same athlete can appear in both training and validation folds. This can
make performance estimates optimistic. Athlete-stratified or
session-stratified splits are the recommended next step.
blocks.zh:
采用分层拆分法在剪辑级别上进行分解。 那个
同样的运动员可以同时出现在训练与验证折中. 这个可以
使业绩估计乐观。 运动员排序或
分会场分会是下一步的建议。

blocks.en: 5.4 Experimental Protocol and Generalization
blocks.zh: 5.4 实验议定书和一般化

blocks.en:
Each clip is trimmed to a 32-frame window. The window contains 15 frames
before the annotated FPOC and 16 frames after it. Raw clips run 200 to
1500 frames at 30 fps before trimming. Frames are resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 . BGR frames are converted to RGB before the ViViT
processor. FPOC localization is described in [ 8 ] and automated
in [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh:
每个片段被修剪成一个32帧的窗口. 窗口包含 15 帧
在附加说明的FPOPC之前,在它之后还有16帧。 原始剪辑运行200至
1500帧在修剪前30英尺处. 框架的大小调整为 224×224 224\times 224 。 BGR 框架在 ViViT 之前转换为 RGB
处理器。 FPOPOC本地化在[8]中描述,并自动
[9]。

blocks.en:
The label schema follows the SATT-3 rubric. Scores 0 and 1 map to risky,
label 1. Scores 2 and 3 map to safe, label 0. Domain experts annotated
all 733 clips. The final distribution is 474 safe clips and 259 risky
clips.
blocks.zh:
标签图案沿袭STAT-3题材. 得分0和1 地图冒险,
标签 1. 安全分数2和3地图,标签 零点 附加说明的领域专家
所有733个片段。 最终分发474个安全片段和259个危险片段
剪辑。

blocks.en:
Augmentation is applied only to training splits after fold construction.
Validation folds contain original clips only. The risky class is targeted
so that training approaches class balance. A subset of safe clips is also
augmented. This reduces the chance that the model separates classes by
augmentation artifacts alone. The quantitative results are tied to the
archived full-data fold directories and the archived metric outputs.
blocks.zh:
增量仅适用于折叠构造后的培训拆分.
校验折叠仅包含原始剪辑. 危险阶层是目标
培训接近班级平衡 一组安全片段也是
扩充。 这减少了模式将班级分开的机会
单是加固文物 量化结果与
存档的完整数据折叠目录和存档的度量输出。

blocks.en:
The generalization scope is narrow. The dataset comes from one
institution with fixed recording conditions. Performance may degrade
under different camera angles, standoff distances, helmet styles, pad
styles, field surfaces, and athlete body types. Clip-level folds may also
inflate recall relative to athlete-stratified or session-stratified
evaluation.
blocks.zh:
概括范围狭窄. 数据集来自一个
具有固定记录条件的机构。 性能可能降低
在不同的相机角度下,悬空距离,头盔样式,垫片
样式、场面和运动员身体类型。 剪贴层折叠也可能
相对于运动员被评为或被评为
评估。

blocks.en: 6 Lessons Learned
blocks.zh: 6 经验教训

blocks.en:
The readme, license, and environment file were reconstructed during
artifact preparation. Rebuilding an environment from a live codebase is
slow and error prone. Recording dependency versions at project start is
much cheaper.
blocks.zh:
读取器、许可证和环境文件在重建期间
文物准备。 从现场代码库重建环境
慢而易误. 项目启动时记录依赖性版本为
更便宜一点

blocks.en:
Metric lineage must be explicit. The heatmap values are threshold-tuned opt_* metrics. A reproducer who uses standard argmax metrics will
not obtain the same table. The artifact therefore writes both metric
families and names them in the output CSV files.
blocks.zh:
计量出身必须明确。 热映射值是阈值调制的 opt__ 度量衡。 使用标准方格马克斯度量衡的复制者会
未获得同样的表格。 因此,该文物写了两个度量
在输出的 CSV 文件内,将家庭命名。

blocks.en:
A shared configuration file would make future audits easier. The main
settings should be captured in one machine-readable file. Scripts should
load that file and apply explicit command-line overrides. This would
reduce ambiguity about focal-loss weights, sampler behavior, and
threshold selection. The focal-loss discrepancy between script defaults
and SLURM logs is the clearest example.
blocks.zh:
共享配置文件将使今后的审计更加容易。 主体
设置应在一个机器可读文件中捕获。 脚本应该
装入文件并应用明确的命令行覆盖。 这会
减少关于焦损重量、采样器行为方面的模糊性,以及
阈值选择。 脚本默认的焦距差异
和SLURM日志是最明显的例子.

blocks.en:
Reviewer data access needs early planning. A data use agreement and a
secure transfer route take time to set up. Teams working with
identifiable participant footage should plan this route during data
collection, not after acceptance.
blocks.zh:
审查者的数据访问需要早期规划. 数据使用协议和
安全转移路线需要时间来设置。 与
可识别的参与者镜头应在数据期间规划这条路线
收集,接受后不进行。

blocks.en:
The L 18 L_{18} design covered a 54-combination factor space with only 18
model trainings. It saved about 108 to 144 GPU-hours compared with an
exhaustive search. The main-effects analysis still isolated a clear
factor: brightness decrease.
blocks.zh:
L 18 LQQ 18}设计覆盖了54个组合因子空间,只有18个
模范训练。 它节省了大约108到144 GPU小时 与一个
彻底搜索。 分析的主要效果还是很明确
系数:亮度下降。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
The headline result of [ 8 ] is reproduced from the released
artifact lineage. run_15 reaches risky recall 0.667 and risky F1
0.588. These values match the reported 0.67 and 0.59 after rounding. The
artifact documents the training script, the threshold-tuned metric files,
and the aggregation path behind the heatmap. Brightness decrease is the
strongest augmentation factor. ViViT without augmentation does not
exceed the C3D baseline in risky recall. Clip-level fold construction is
the main protocol limitation. Athlete-stratified or session-stratified
evaluation is the recommended next step.
blocks.zh:
[8]的头条结果转录自发布
文物世系. 运行_15 达到风险召回 0.667 和风险 F1
0.588 (英语). 这些数值与四舍五入后报告的0.67和0.59相符。 那个
文物记录培训脚本 阈值调制的计量文件,
和热图后面的集合路径。 亮度的降低是
最强扩增因子. 没有增强的 ViViT 不
超过 C3D 基线,在危险召回。 剪贴层折叠构造
主要协议限制。 暂停或暂停会议
评价是建议采取的下一步。
